title: Homolog blob (HOM)
description: data/homolog.json: conservation and specificity data. Every per-position array and every aligned sequence (map) has one entry per entry of resis, in the same order, so a residue number finds its column through resis. Field meaning, producers and consumers are in docs/data_contract.md section 5. Which species, labels and keys the pages show is decided by profile.specificity (HOM.species, show, subject and kind are the legacy way and are still read).

resis.description: Target residues, UniProt numbering, ascending. Equal to the campaign target.resi (the union of the runs' constructs).

seq.description: Reference (human) residue at each entry of resis, one letter.

cons.description: Conservation per position, 0..1: 1 - (Shannon entropy of the ortholog column / log2 20).

ident.description: Share of ortholog sequences, among those with a residue in the column, that carry the reference residue.

grade.description: ConSurf-style grade, 1 variable to 9 conserved, computed from the orthologs only (rank of cons * max(cover, 0.3) in nine bins).

cover.description: Share of orthologs with a residue (not a gap) in the column.

n_orth.description: Number of ortholog sequences that went into cons, ident, grade and cover.

orth.description: Ortholog sequences aligned to the reference. The pages pick their panel from here through profile.specificity.species (by organism name or by 'acc:<accession>').

org.description: Organism name (as in UniProt OS) or a clade label.

ident.description: Identity of the whole alignment to the reference.

map.description: Aligned residue per entry of resis, one letter, '-' for a gap. Length = len(resis).

extra.description: Entry added by hand after the panel was built (kept out of n_orth).

par.description: Paralogs (related proteins of the same organism) aligned to the reference. Empty for targets without a paralog panel (viruses).

gene.description: Gene symbol; the pages key paralogs by it.

cov.description: Share of the aligned region covered by the paralog alignment.

ident_igv.description: LEGACY name. Identity over the aligned reference region. Same quantity as ident_ref.

ident_ref.description: NEW generic name for ident_igv: identity over the aligned reference region.

map.description: Aligned residue per entry of resis, '-' for a gap. Length = len(resis).

species.description: LEGACY panel selection: [[organism name or 'acc:<accession>', label, key], ...]. profile.specificity.species is the new place; the exporter writes this mirror for old pages.

show.description: LEGACY. Keys shown in the map's specificity block.

subject.description: LEGACY. Name of the protein the conservation is about (default: the target).

kind.description: LEGACY. virus removes the paralog and decoy sections.

note.description: Free text: where the sequences came from.

consurf.description: NEW. Optional ConSurf-DB overlay (academic, non-commercial use; off unless the user turns it on). grade: ConSurf grade per entry of resis (1 variable to 9 conserved), null where ConSurf has none.
